name: stackblitz-sdk-patterns
description: Design a durable WebContainer lifecycle adapter for filesystem, process, event, preview, and teardown operations. Use when multiple UI components need WebContainer access or an integration has race-prone boot and cleanup logic. Trigger with "WebContainer SDK patterns", "manage WebContainer lifecycle", or "StackBlitz runtime adapter".

findings.excerpt: Use `Read`, `Glob`, and `Grep` to map imports, boot calls, process ownership, filesystem mutations, event subscriptions, and teardown paths. Use `WebFetch` only
